title: Noor and the Parish
author: Ada Kavanagh
blurb: Ansel Almeida, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
